profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY, with a European headquarters recently opened in London. The company describes itself as building foundational "Real-World Intelligence" that can understand, simulate, and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that foundation. Its core technology is GWM-1, which it calls a state-of-the-art General World Model, and it has announced a planned $100M investment in the UK AI ecosystem alongside the London expansion.

Runway's primary tracked product is its video generation platform, which sits within the video generation and editing category. The company also offers a developer platform called Runway Dev, which includes the Runway Media Router, described as the first preference-optimized router for generative media. Additional capabilities the site references include policy inference and evaluation and synthetic data generation, all powered by GWM-1.

On the legal side, Runway faces several active cases in federal court. David Vance Gardner has filed suits against Runway AI, Inc. in both the Southern District of New York and the Central District of California, and the company is also named as a defendant in cases brought by Businessing LLC and Ace Cam, Inc. in the Southern District of New York. Runway is additionally listed as a party in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the Northern District of California. The held facts record 299 law-related data points associated with New York jurisdiction.
